αἰπήν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with πόλιν ’steep city’), distinct from the fixed phrase αἰπὺς ὄλεθρος
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, destiny; fem. nom. sg., used impersonally with an inf.: ’it is not his lot to…’ · also plain subject: ’portion, lot’ (ἅσσα οἱ αἶσα … νήσαντο ’whatever his portion … spun for him’)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’
βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’
βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
βαρὺ: βαρύς — heavy, deep; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’heavily’
βλεφάροισι: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’
γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg.
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg. (χρεὼ γίγνεται ’a need arises’)
γαμβρὸς: γαμβρός — son-in-law, relative by marriage; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γόοιο: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’
δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίκαιοι: δίκαιος — just, righteous; masc. nom. pl.
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg.
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμόν: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’
εἴπ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (εἴπ’ = εἰπέ)
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θέσπιν: θέσπις — god-given, inspired; fem. acc. sg.
θεουδής: θεουδής — god-fearing, pious; adj. of two terminations, masc./fem. nom. sg.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender)
θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάλεον: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἐκάλουν)
κάλλιον: καλός — good, fine, fair; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’better, finer’
κάλλιόν: καλός — beautiful, fine; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’more fitting’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated (κέκλυτε)
κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’
κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’)
κεῖθι: κεῖθι — there; adv., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
κοῖλον: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. acc. sg. (κοῖλον λόχον ’the hollow ambush’, i.e. inside the wooden horse)
κόσμον: κόσμος — order, arrangement, due order; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
λίγειαν: λιγύς — clear-sounding, piercing, shrill; fem. acc. sg., epic accent (= λιγεῖαν)
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’
λείβων: λείβω — pour, let fall drop by drop; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (δάκρυα λείβων ’pouring tears’), kept distinct from δάκρυ χέων ’shedding a tear’
λόχον: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. acc. sg. (of the men hidden inside the wooden horse)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μεγάθυμον: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. acc. sg.
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat. · also + acc., ’after, behind’ (μεθ’ ἡμιόνους ’behind the mules’)
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μοῦσ: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῦσ’ = μοῦσα)
μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νοήματα: νόημα — thought, design, purpose; neut. acc. pl.
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νῆες
ξείνοιο: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οἶτον: οἶτος — fate, doom (usually evil); masc. acc. sg.
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πίονας: πίων — fat, rich; masc./fem. acc. pl. (fem. usually πίειρα)
πεπνυμένα: πέπνυμαι — be prudent, wise (perf. w/ pres. sense, from πνέω ’breathe’); part. neut. acc. pl.: ’prudent (counsels)’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περικλυτός: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg.
περιναιετάουσιν: περιναιετάω — lie round about, be situated nearby; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic περιναιετῶσιν)
πετράων: πέτρη — rock; fem. gen. pl., epic (πετράων = Attic πετρῶν)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
πομπῆς: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. gen. sg., + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by περί: ’about a conveyance’ · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on account of an escort’
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
πραπίδεσσι: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’)
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πρὸ: πρό — before, in front; prep. + gen.; also adv. or preverb in tmesis, ’ahead, forward’ (πρὸ … ἔαξεν ’broke ahead’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
στενάχοντος: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. gen. sg. (object of ἀκούω, ’heard him groaning’)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέθουσι: τελέθω — come to be, become, be; pres. 3 pl.
τελέσειεν: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he bring to pass’
τερπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take pleasure, enjoy oneself; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’)
τινας: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. acc. pl.: ’some, certain’ · also with a relative, οὕς τινας ’whichever, whoever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαιήκεσσι: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
φιληρέτμοισι: φιλήρετμος — fond of the oar, oar-loving (φίλος + ἐρετμόν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
φιλόξεινοι: φιλόξεινος — loving strangers, hospitable; masc. nom. pl.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
φόρμιγγα: φόρμιγξ — lyre, the singer’s stringed instrument; fem. acc. sg.
φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
χερείων: χερείων — worse, inferior; epic comparative of κακός (= Attic χείρων); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
ἀγροὺς: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. acc. pl.
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, declare; impf. 3 pl.
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg. · also the city Athens: εὐρυάγυιαν Ἀθήνην ’wide-streeted Athens’
ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard, on hearing’
ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
ἀλκίνοος: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; nom. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’)
ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; dat. sg.: ’to a husband’
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντιθέῳ: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. dat. sg.
ἀοιδός: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
ἀοιδὸς: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι (mid. ἀπόλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to perish’
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’
ἄγ: ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἄγ’ = ἄγε): ’he led’ · also ἄγε (elided ἄγ’), the interjection ’come!’, 2 sg. imper., used even to a group: ’come, come now’
ἄγαλμα: ἄγαλμα — a thing that delights, ornament, offering for a god; neut. acc. sg.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’
ἄγριοι: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. pl.
ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι), also with a gen.: ’near him’
ἄκουσα: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσα)
ἄκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of the thing heard
ἄκρης: ἄκρη — top, peak, crest; fem. gen. sg., + κατά: ’down from the top’, of a wave breaking from its crest
ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδίδαξε: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 sg., augmented, with double acc.: ’taught (them the songs)’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκπερόωσιν: ἐκπεράω — cross over, traverse; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐκπερῶσι)
ἐλάνθανε: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg.: ’escaped the notice of’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπεκλώσαντο: ἐπικλώθω — spin (fate) for, allot by spinning; aor. 3 pl. mid.
ἐπεφράσατ: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of, perceive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεφράσατ’ = ἐπεφράσατο)
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐρύσαντο: ἐρύω — draw, pull; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they drew (the meat) off (the spits)’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλός: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν), used as an imperative: ’hold on!’ · also inf. as the wish after αἲ γάρ: ’(would that you) might have (my daughter)’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’)
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔφασκε: φημί — say, promise; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-: ’kept saying, kept promising’
ἠεροειδέι: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dusky; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠύτ: ἠύτε — like, as; epic particle, elided (ἠύτ’ = ἠύτε)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., address: ’leaders!’
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’began (to speak)’ · also + gen.: ’led off’ (ἤρχετο μολπῆς ’led off the dance’)
ἥατ: ἧμαι — sit; epic perf./impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἥατ’ = ἥατο, Attic ἧντο)
ἥατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s original digamma, contracted; the same augment as the uncontracted ἑήνδανε in this part; unaugmented ἄνδανε); + dat.: ’was pleasing to’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδοῦσα: ὁράω (εἶδον) — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’seeing’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἵππῳ: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. sg. (of the wooden horse of Troy, ἵππῳ ξεστῷ)
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ὅσσ’ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται ’as many creatures as come to be upon earth’
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
